name: fey-beta-video
description: Fey Beta motion video (Remotion) + app screenshot capture

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts FeyBeta out/fey-beta-16x9.mp4 --browser-executable="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"
scripts.render:vertical: remotion render src/index.ts FeyBetaVertical out/fey-beta-9x16.mp4 --browser-executable="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"
scripts.still: remotion still src/index.ts FeyBeta out/still.png --browser-executable="/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome"
